lines.zh: 冰封山峰的风，把我的毛吹得倒竖。
lines.en: Ice-peak wind bristles my fur.
Who left prints here?
This slope is slick — I grab the rock.

lines.zh: 雪地里我的脚印深得很。
lines.en: My prints sink deep in snow.
The snow runs deep; every step sinks.
I breathe out; a cloud of white.
I follow the wind to a sheltered spot.
The frozen ground is hard as iron.
Ice spikes underfoot — I walk around them.
I have walked that ridge trail before.
Frozen stiff, I shuffle along.
The ice crusts in my fur click as I move.

lines.zh: 冰刺林里，雪埋过我的膝盖。
lines.en: In the icy spikes, snow buries my knees.
On the frozen peak, even the wind stops.

lines.zh: 雪埋过膝盖，我不觉得冷。
lines.en: Knee-deep snow and I don't feel cold.
All this white makes me dizzy.
I roar, and the mountain answers.
The frost in my throat has not thawed.
The wind died. Too quiet.
Half a pound of ice hides in my fur.
I gnaw the ice off my nails.
I sit, and the snow reaches my waist.
Dressed that thin — aren't you cold?

lines.zh: 你在发抖，雪坡上可别停。
lines.en: You are shivering; do not stop on the snow slope.
Standing on this slope — don't stop moving.
The smell of fire comes off you.
Only my prints belong on this snow.

lines.zh: 冰峰上的雪，我踩下去就没到腰。
lines.en: On the frozen peak the snow reaches my waist.
Yeti? Doesn't look like one.
Frozen peaks are my home.
Stand back — my nose is sharp.
The frost breath sits in my mouth.
Who's this bold?
Thick hide, but it still hurts.
In the snow, you've made me angry.
I grit my teeth and bear it.
Blood on the snow — far too visible.
Frost gathers in my throat.

lines.zh: 我身上的白毛，被血染红。
lines.en: Blood stains my white fur.

lines.zh: 雪地里，我的脚印比谁都大。
lines.en: In the snow, my prints are bigger than anyone's.
Barely scraped the white hide.
You owe me for that one.
Warm — I want something warm.
That meat is still steaming.
That one thing — that's all I want.
The ice spikes are my home.
Leave a piece of meat and I stop chasing.
That thing glows, and it stings my eyes.
On the snowy peaks, I hide from no one.
Leave the meat — I don't chase on snow.
One breath turns snow to ice.
You've got food in that pocket.

lines.zh: 雪崩似的撞击，我的骨头响了。
lines.en: Like an avalanche's blow, my bones clicked.
Plant your feet — don't fall.
You stepped on my shadow.

lines.zh: 我一口霜气，能把雪堆冻硬。
lines.en: One frost breath hardens the snow.
I can't make room — go around.
Shoulder to shoulder, you lose.
Don't shove — I'm a big one.
That knock numbed my teeth.
The path is narrow — you back off.
You rubbed off a tuft of my fur.
Ignore those villagers downhill.
Your fur is white as mine.
Roar once, and I know you.
Don't go — dawn is far off.
I have lined the cave with grass.
You are snowier than I am.
In the snow we stand closer.
I will wait the whole winter.
Press close — the wind is fierce.

lines.zh: 冰封山峰的霜结在我毛上。
lines.en: Frost from the frozen peaks sets in my fur.

lines.zh: 冰封山峰上，我的毛全白了。
lines.en: On the frozen peaks, my fur is all white.
Who dumped food in the snow?

lines.zh: 我吐出的气能冻住石头。
lines.en: My breath could freeze stone.
This iron shard can shave ice.

lines.zh: 雪地里亮的东西，我先捡。
lines.en: Whatever shines in the snow, I pick up first.
Shiny — I'll keep it.
Pick it up and tuck it in my fur.
This can crack the frozen ground.
Another one — I can carry it.
My pouch is deep enough.
The one that moved — that's you.
I've fixed on the warmth.
Your warm scent gives you away.
Kin — this way.
The blizzard covers my approach.
Don't play at being a rock — you breathed.
A flicker of shadow — locked.
In the snow, my breath turns to frost.
This time you don't get away.
My white coat is thicker than this snow.
You knocked over my snow pile.
Found you on the snow slope.
The frost has gathered in my throat.
Turn around — I'm right here.
The trail stops right here.
I smell your sweat.
The ice is slick — you won't get far.
Don't stop — stopping ends you.

lines.zh: 冰封山峰上，只有我踩出脚印。
lines.en: On the frozen peaks, only I leave tracks.
I hear the snow crunching.
The wind carries your sound to my ears.
Slow down; the snow will swallow you.
My stride is long — one step, your three.
You turn; I go straight.

lines.zh: 我这一口气，能冻住你的脸。
lines.en: One breath from me can frost your face.
You circle; I walk straight.
Which tree are you hiding behind?
Your prints in the snow — I watch them.
On an ice wall you won't climb far.

lines.zh: 我这身长毛，几个月没沾睡眠。
lines.en: Months have passed without sleep in this fur.

lines.zh: 雪怪吐着白气，跑也没用。
lines.en: The yeti breathes white — running won't help.
Above the snowline, I know the way.

lines.zh: 雪坡上的脚印，都是我的。
lines.en: Every print on this slope is mine.
I follow the sound of your breath.
I keep sniffing your trail.
The slope is steep; you can't run fast.
Yell if it hurts — don't hold it in.
I slam down and the ground shakes.
Lift you up, then slam you down.
Your shield means nothing to me.
My fist is harder than ice.
This claw will leave a mark.

lines.zh: 我呼气，你的睫毛会结冰。
lines.en: I breathe, and your lashes frost.
Raise an arm to block, and it snaps.

lines.zh: 冰霜吐息，先冻住你的脚。
lines.en: Frost breath — your feet first.
Here are the teeth — see them?
My mouth opens and frost pours.

lines.zh: 霜吐息一出，我的手就重。
lines.en: Frost breath out — my hands come down heavy.
Come again — I'm barely trying.
One slap of mine shatters ice.
Take this and you'll wake up.

lines.zh: 我的冰霜吐息，比雪还冷。
lines.en: My frost breath is colder than snow.

lines.zh: 我呼出的霜，先冻住你的脚。
lines.en: My frost breath freezes your feet first.
One swipe and the snow caves in.

lines.zh: 我一口霜吐出去，草全白了。
lines.en: One frost breath and the grass goes white.
Run where you like — I'll catch up.
The wind is harsh — just how I like it.
Frost breath, hhhh. Did you hear that?
I slept a whole winter in this mountain.
I shake my fur; snow falls everywhere.
I open my eyes to nothing but white.
woods. I've arrived.
First, a good roar.

lines.zh: 我从冰缝里出来，先吐一口霜。
lines.en: I come out of the ice crack and breathe frost first.
Only from the frozen peak can I see far.
I dig my way out from under the snowbank.

lines.zh: 刚睁眼就饿了，冰峰没草。
lines.en: Awake and hungry; no grass on the frozen peak.
The snow slope is too steep to stand straight.
This coat dreads fire most.
Rolled off the cliff — my head spins.
My fur soaks up water and drags me down.
Gunpowder stings my nose.
An arrow is stuck in my shoulder.
The chant clings to me, burning.
No meat in the snow — my stomach cramps.
My fur stands on end, all numb.
So empty there isn't even snow.
